method: cargo suite run -c clang-O2,keel-O -n 7: whole-process wall time of each benchmark executable, including startup, in rotating rounds with reversed rotations and a copied Clang executable as an identical-binary control. Outputs must match before timing.
ratio_direction: Keel time / Clang time; above 1 means Keel-compiled code is slower
ratio_statistic: median over rounds of the paired Keel/Clang time ratio; application geomeans are over its workloads, the overall geomean is over applications
